summary.text: Bob Merski is a member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 2, which he has represented since December 2018, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He advanced from both the Democratic and Republican primaries on May 19, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Merski assumed office in the House on December 1, 2018.
